title: ItStakeholder
description: IT ontology composite — materialization of the ontology.json axes for TogafStakeholder. Typing: extends TogafStakeholder (chain converges to its GSM base). Facets are mounted as optional named properties keyed by lowerCamelCase of the facet's globally-unique title (the catalogue's facet mount rule — collision-free instance-level namespacing; JSON Schema does not namespace instance properties). Mounted axes — attributed-to: ProvAttribution; responsibility-of: ProvAssociation, ProvDelegation. Source: frameworks/it/ontology.json (static materialization; generator planned).

provAssociation.description: Optional ProvAssociation facet mount (ontology axis: responsibility-of). Facet-internal required members apply only when this mount is present.

provAttribution.description: Optional ProvAttribution facet mount (ontology axis: attributed-to). Facet-internal required members apply only when this mount is present.

provDelegation.description: Optional ProvDelegation facet mount (ontology axis: responsibility-of). Facet-internal required members apply only when this mount is present.
